order: device (Metal then CPU), fixture, round; rotate reference/before/after each round
cpu_epoch: Repeat all CPU arms after externally triggered host restart, retaining the complete previous campaign under pre-restart names; same protocol and start-load threshold.
final_epoch: Repeat all Metal and CPU arms after host restart on exact final binaries. Complete earlier epochs retained separately. No thresholds changed.

reference_query_exception.reason: The host remained fully CPU-busy during the preserved quiet-start attempt. Collect context, without using it for matched-host latency or release acceptance claims.
